title: WHO editorial style manual
_comment: An IRIS capture staged by the owner, 2026-09-20. The filename is kept as the capture produced it; the `-info` suffix marks a full item record, matching the wpr-rdo capture's own convention rather than a new one.

files.note: The DSpace FULL ITEM RECORD. Same kind as the wpr-rdo capture's `-info.pdf`, and it exists for the same reason: it is the only place the item's real Dublin Core lives. Before it, this item's record here was INFERRED, and the two disagree -- see the catalogue record's own note.

The PUBLICATION ITSELF — the ORIGINAL bitstream this item's catalogue node names, and the bytes `library/who-pub-tps-931` was derived from (its `structure.json` records this same sha256). The only scanned entry in the corpus, and the only one exercising the OCR path. Relocated here 2026-09-21 from `cat-harness/uploads/` (bean `yl5w`, issue #663): #477 moved `library/` into `who-iris/` and left the sources behind, so the catalogue's `localPath` claimed bytes that were one instance over. Recorded in this intake rather than only in the catalogue, because this file describes what is IN this directory.
